text:
marta: FYI onboarding smoke from a customer: our Node sampleapp started returning mismatched vectors after an intermittent 401 -> refresh. Looks like rerank pairs shifted.

dan: Can you paste the raw request/resp? SDK/lang?

marta: Node v0.10 sampleapp. Outgoing batch (trimmed): { items:[{id:\"k1\"},{id:\"k2\"},{id:\"k3\"}] }

Observed service body (merged after retry): { results:[{id:\"k2\",vector:[...],score:0.9},{id:\"k1\",vector:[...],score:0.7},{id:\"k3\",vector:[...],score:0.4}] }

Node helper docs promise caller-aligned order but helper returned vectors attached to original indices, which caused k1/k2 swap.

hui: Repro'd locally by faking auth-refresh. Two root causes: 1) runtime merges partial shard replies by append, not id; 2) Node batch helper assumed stable order and used index mapping.

marta: Also found quantized path returns embedding as base64 fp16 under field \"embedding\" and dim as string. Float32Array.from blows up. So schema drift + ordering assumptions together.

dan: Short-term fixes we agreed on: - Client: normalize resp by id before mapping back to inputs. Example: const byId = new Map(resp.results.map(r=>[r.id,r])); return items.map(i=>byId.get(i.id)); - Client: accept both \"vector\" (numeric array) and \"embedding\" (base64), coerce types, validate dims.

hui: I'll open a Node helper PR that adds id normalization, base64 fp16 decode, and a unit that shuffles response ordering to catch retries.

infra-bot: note: platform change PR #6310 modified quantized merge semantics last week; tagging platform-team.

marta: Medium-term: platform should include canonical id in each response entry and a stable schema header (X-Embedding-Format) to indicate numeric vs b64, and ensure dim is numeric. I've filed PLATFORM-1428 for this.

dan: Also flagging SDK parity doc drift: Python still uses \"results\" while Node docs show \"items\" in helpers. We'll standardize names and add a cross-SDK schema conformance test that loads fixtures for both numeric and quantized paths.

hui: For sampleapp onboarding, adding a checklist: 1) validate vector length == expected, 2) coerce numbers, 3) index response by id, 4) fail loudly on missing ids. Adding a prominent README note: \"Do not rely on response ordering.\"

qa-bot: nightly/sampleapp-compat run shows shuffle-preserve test flaky; added flaky marker until helper PR lands.

marta: Thanks. Who wants to own the docs update?

dan: I will update the devex onboarding doc and sampleapp snippets to show the normalize-by-id pattern. I'll also link the PR and the PLATFORM-1428 ticket.

hui: PR ready in a few hours with tests.

marta: Great. This should reduce onboarding noise and prevent silent mis-rankings for customers.
